sentences.text:
[being disposed of matter] 02.01.2026 Present: Ms. Sneh Bhimta, Advocate vice Ms. Shreya
Chauhan, Advocate, for the Non-Applicant/ Appellant.
Mr. Ashok Kumar Sharma, Advocate, for the Applicants/Respondents.
of Omp No.1590 of 2025 in Omp (M) No.58 of 2025 in Arb.
Appeal No.525 of 2025 Instant application has been filed under Section rt 151 CPC, seeking releasing of compensation amount.
2. Pertinently, in pursuance to Land Acquisition Proceedings, an Award was passed by CALA concerned.

NHAI filed objections under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, which were dismissed by Learned District Judge, Bilaspur, on 13.06.2024, on the ground that the aforesaid objections were beyond limitation.

2. The order passed by Learned District Judge was assailed by NHAI in the proceedings under Section 37 of the said Act, vide OMP (M) No.58 of 2025 in Arbitration Appeal No.525 of 2025, which were dismissed by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court on 13.08.2025.

Para-3 of the application indicates that pursuant to Acquisition Proceedings and Award, an amount of Rs.98,32,926/-
stands deposited in the Registry of this Court on 13.08.2025.
3.

Reference of application, including Annexure .
A-2 dated 09.07.2025 indicates that the aforesaid amount is due and payable amongst the applicants, Amar Singh, Mohar Singh [sic Mehar Singh] and Piar Singh.

In view of the above facts, application for release of has been filed by Mohar Singh; Rama Nand; and Dharam Singh, but the documents placed on records do not prima- rt facie reveal that the amounts are due and payable to these applicants.

4. In this situation, as prayed, let Reply/Instructions to the application be filed, within a week and the matter be listed on 09.01.2026.
(Ranjan Sharma) Judge January 02, 2026 [Bhardwaj]
